sources.label: Official Marin ballot type 53 sample ballot

notes: Only ballot type 53 is verified and imported.
County PDF text was decoded from its embedded character mapping and compared with the published guide and candidate list.
Candidate names and vote limits are from the complete sample ballot; First Appellate District and statewide contests were individually checked before sharing.
Direct PDF downloads returned 403 during this pass; the published guide and web PDF extraction were available. Other Marin styles remain unverified.
